title: Multi-resolution enhancement for full-spectrum neural representations
summary:
Nature Machine Intelligence, Published online: 24 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01287-9

Ni et al. present WIEN-INR, an implicit neural representation for scientific data compression. It operates in the multiscale wavelet domain to improve compression as well as preserve fine details and signal fidelity.

title: A roadmap for end-to-end task-agnostic exoskeleton control
summary:
Nature Machine Intelligence, Published online: 24 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01297-7

Shepherd et al. propose end-to-end AI control of lower-limb exoskeletons based on real-time estimates of physiological signals.

title: Harnessing implicit neural representations for scientific data compression
summary:
Nature Machine Intelligence, Published online: 24 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01290-0

Implicit neural representations can turn massive scientific measurements into compact functions. A hierarchical approach now helps these representations preserve richer fine-scale detail.
